name: locker.weather_wait
description: Launch a harness-owned Sandy Creek locker baseline from the captured locker-ready save fixture, force a cold locker probe state through the debug menu, then wait for a real camp-locker packet.

steps.label: wait_for_gameplay_settle
steps.expected_visible_fact: Sandy Creek locker-ready gameplay is loaded before forcing the cold locker probe state; this is startup/load footing only.

steps.label: force_cold_temperature
steps.expected_visible_fact: Debug force-temperature returns to the live map after setting the probe state to 35F.

steps.label: wait_for_locker_service
steps.expected_visible_fact: A bounded turn window completes on the locker-ready fixture; practical gear proof depends on same-run camp locker queued/plan/after/serviced artifact lines.

steps.label: audit_locker_service_artifacts
steps.abort_reason: same-run debug artifact lacked the camp locker queued/plan/after/serviced service sequence
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run debug artifact proves the bounded locker service sequence was queued, planned, applied, and serviced

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_before_locker_temperature_save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player file mtime baseline is recorded after locker service and before saving the forced-temperature state

steps.label: open_save_prompt_after_locker_temperature
steps.abort_reason: screen text did not prove the case-sensitive Save and quit prompt before confirming the locker-temperature save
steps.expected_visible_fact: the case-sensitive Save and quit prompt is open before persisting the locker probe temperature

steps.label: confirm_save_after_locker_temperature
steps.expected_visible_fact: the proven save prompt is confirmed so the following mtime and weather audits can verify same-run writeback

steps.label: audit_player_save_mtime_after_locker_temperature_save
steps.abort_reason: saved-player file mtime did not advance after confirming the locker-temperature save
steps.expected_visible_fact: saved-player file mtime advanced after the confirmed locker-temperature save

steps.label: audit_saved_weather_after_locker_temperature
steps.abort_reason: saved dimension weather metadata did not contain 35F after same-run locker-temperature save/writeback
steps.expected_visible_fact: same-run saved dimension weather metadata contains the forced 35F locker probe temperature
